Usage: yp <command> [options]

                                    Commands                                    
╭──────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Command      │ Description                                                   │
├──────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ setup        │ Configure AI provider in the TUI (auto-falls-back to --wizard │
│              │ in CI); pass --wizard to force the legacy flow                │
│ commit       │ Stage, commit and push changes with an AI-generated message   │
│ pr           │ Triage and act on Azure DevOps PRs                            │
│              │ (list/show/comments/reply/create) or generate an AI           │
│              │ description with --detailed                                   │
│ checkout     │ Interactive branch checkout                                   │
│ azure-devops │ Manage Azure DevOps resources                                 │
│ diff         │ Show working-tree or branch-to-branch diff (supports --stat,  │
│              │ --hunks, --files, --json)                                     │
│ skill        │ Install the yp skill for your AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor,  │
│              │ Gemini CLI...)                                                │
╰──────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Global flags (work without a subcommand):
  --version, -V  Print the assembly version and exit 0
  --help, -h     Show this help
  --no-spinner   Skip the AnsiConsole.Status() spinner for the long ops in this 
command (also honored via the YITPUSH_NO_SPINNER env var; auto-applied when 
stdout is redirected)

commit options:

│ Flag                                                           │ Description │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────┤
